title: MoralBERT: A Fine-Tuned Language Model for Capturing Moral Values in Social Discussions
reasoning: The paper focuses on fine-tuning and benchmarking language models to detect moral values within social media text, using the Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) as a framework. It evaluates the model's performance in capturing psychological 'foundations' of moral reasoning such as Care, Fairness, Loyalty, Authority, Purity, and Liberty.
